/-- **W2 space row** (design §12 R3, decision 12.3;
annotates `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM` beside its
`redirectTM_computes`/`redirectTM_live` contract pair). Redirection costs
no space, per tape and exactly: the redirected machine's tape actions are
the source's verbatim, before and after the source halt.

**Proof sketch.** `redirect_run`'s configuration correspondence preserves
work tapes and heads at every time (the live loop is stationary and the
simulation phase copies the source's tape actions), so the two head
trajectories coincide pointwise and the visited images agree. -/
theorem redirectTM_spaceUsedByTape (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool)
    (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.spaceUsedByTape
        ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t i
      = M.tm.spaceUsedByTape (M.tm.initCfg x) t i := by
  unfold MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead
  congr 1
  apply Finset.image_congr
  intro u _
  dsimp only
  rw [catalog_redirect_run]
  rfl

/-- The fixed-width incrementer uses zero work space on every input at every time,
because it has no work tapes. -/
theorem incFixedTM_spaceUsed (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    incFixedTM.tm.spaceUsed (incFixedTM.tm.initCfg x) t = 0 := by
  exact MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_zero_tapes_eq_zero _ _ rfl

/-- **W2 space row** (design §12 R3, decision 12.3;
annotates `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM` beside its
`redirectTM_computes`/`redirectTM_live` contract pair). Redirection costs
no space, per tape and exactly: the redirected machine's tape actions are
the source's verbatim, before and after the source halt.

**Proof sketch.** `redirect_run`'s configuration correspondence preserves
work tapes and heads at every time (the live loop is stationary and the
simulation phase copies the source's tape actions), so the two head
trajectories coincide pointwise and the visited images agree. -/
theorem redirectTM_spaceUsedByTape (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool)
    (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.spaceUsedByTape
        ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t i
      = M.tm.spaceUsedByTape (M.tm.initCfg x) t i := by
  rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card, MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card]
  congr 1
  ext p
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.mem_visitedByTapeHead_iff, (redirectTM_runFrom M haltOn x _).2.2.2.1]

/-- The diagonal pairing machine uses zero work-tape space on every input at every time.
It has no work tapes, so `Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_zero_tapes_eq_zero` applies.
[AB09, §4.1] -/
theorem pairDiagTM_spaceUsed (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    pairDiagTM.tm.spaceUsed (pairDiagTM.tm.initCfg x) t = 0 := by
  exact MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_zero_tapes_eq_zero _ _ rfl

/-- A run ending in a designated live stop state first enters the stop states by its deadline,
and that first entry is already the final configuration, provided every stop configuration is
fixed by one step.

**Proof sketch.** Choose the least stop-state time with `Nat.find`. Minimality gives the
strict earlier-time cut. The fixed-step hypothesis keeps every subsequent configuration equal
to that first entry; `runFrom_add` then identifies it with the given final configuration. -/
theorem exists_first_entry_of_fixed {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*}
    {input : List Symbol} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State)
    (stop : State → Prop) (c d : Cfg k Symbol State input) (T : ℕ)
    (hfix : ∀ z : Cfg k Symbol State input,
      (∃ q, z.state = some q ∧ stop q) → tm.step z = z)
    (hd : ∃ q, d.state = some q ∧ stop q) (hT : tm.runFrom c T = d) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, (∀ j < t, ¬∃ q, (tm.runFrom c j).state = some q ∧ stop q) ∧
      tm.runFrom c t = d := by
  classical
  have hh : ∃ t, ∃ q, (tm.runFrom c t).state = some q ∧ stop q :=
    ⟨T, by rw [hT]; exact hd⟩
  let t := Nat.find hh
  have ht : t ≤ T := Nat.find_min' hh (by rw [hT]; exact hd)
  have hs : ∃ q, (tm.runFrom c t).state = some q ∧ stop q := Nat.find_spec hh
  have hfixed : tm.step (tm.runFrom c t) = tm.runFrom c t := hfix _ hs
  have hconst (n : ℕ) : tm.runFrom (tm.runFrom c t) n = tm.runFrom c t := by
    induction n with
    | zero => exact runFrom_zero
    | succ n ih => rw [runFrom_succ_eq_step, hfixed]; exact ih
  refine ⟨t, ht, fun j hj => Nat.find_min hh hj, ?_⟩
  have he := tm.runFrom_add c t (T - t)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le ht, hT, hconst] at he
  exact he.symm
